title: Class Template Member Functions
learningObjectives: Identify template parameters and required operations.
Design a reusable generic utility or type.

understand.concept: Template member functions use the template parameters. Definitions generally need to be visible at instantiation, often by placing implementation in headers.
understand.whyItMatters: Header visibility allows compilers to instantiate template members for requested types.
understand.explain: Keep template definitions visible. When a member definition is outside the class, repeat the template declaration and qualify the class with its parameter.

examples.title: Inline members
examples.code: template<class T>class Holder{public:Holder(T v):value(v){}T get()const{return value;}private:T value;};
examples.explanation: Members are defined in the template class body.

examples.title: Out-of-class member
examples.code: template<class T>class Square{public:T area()const;private:T side;};\ntemplate<class T>T Square<T>::area()const{return side*side;
examples.explanation: Out-of-class definition repeats template and class qualification.

examples.title: Set/get member
examples.code: template<class T>struct Slot{void set(T v){value=v;}T get()const{return value;}private:T value{};};\nSlot<int> s;s.set(5);
examples.explanation: Member functions use the template type.

examples.title: Value initialization
examples.explanation: Member is value-initialized for selected T.

examples.title: Header visibility
examples.code: // Header contains template declaration and definition\ntemplate<class T>T twice(T v){return v+v;}
examples.explanation: Definition must be visible when instantiating.

practise.guidedTask: Analyze each Class Template Member Functions example: identify parameters, requirements, deduced or explicit arguments, and instantiated behavior.
practise.independentTask: Write a generic C++ utility or type demonstrating class template member functions. Test two supported types, one boundary case, and one unsupported/constrained type; explain why it is or is not accepted.
hints: Begin with a concrete example before generalizing.
Name template parameters for their roles.

questions.explanation: Compiler needs template definitions to instantiate.
Template member uses its type parameter.
